# Olive Kids Trains Planes Trucks Bogo Backpack

Real-object scan by Google LLC, CC-BY-4.0. Original metric scale retained. See LICENSE.txt and provenance.json for attribution.

model.usdc: Z-up USD rigid body, textured mesh, convex collision. model.xml: MuJoCo free body. Mass and friction are estimates. Strap and handle gaps are closed by the convex collision hull; unsuitable for strap grasp/contact validation. No soft-body simulation, human fitting, or screening logic.
